mapper.update: insert into toolbox_tool_user_click_states(tool_id, user_id, last_counted_at) values (#{toolId}, #{userId}, #{clickedAt}) on conflict (tool_id, user_id) do update set last_counted_at = excluded.last_counted_at where toolbox_tool_user_click_states.last_counted_at <= #{windowStart}

merge into toolbox_tool_user_click_states target using (values (#{toolId}, #{userId}, #{clickedAt})) incoming(tool_id, user_id, last_counted_at) on target.tool_id = incoming.tool_id and target.user_id = incoming.user_id when matched and target.last_counted_at <= #{windowStart} then update set last_counted_at = incoming.last_counted_at when not matched then insert (tool_id, user_id, last_counted_at) values (incoming.tool_id, incoming.user_id, incoming.last_counted_at)

insert into toolbox_tool_click_totals(tool_id, click_count, last_counted_at, updated_at) values (#{toolId}, 1, #{countedAt}, #{countedAt}) on conflict (tool_id) do update set click_count = toolbox_tool_click_totals.click_count + 1, last_counted_at = excluded.last_counted_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

merge into toolbox_tool_click_totals target using (values (#{toolId}, #{countedAt})) incoming(tool_id, counted_at) on target.tool_id = incoming.tool_id when matched then update set click_count = target.click_count + 1, last_counted_at = incoming.counted_at, updated_at = incoming.counted_at when not matched then insert (tool_id, click_count, last_counted_at, updated_at) values (incoming.tool_id, 1, incoming.counted_at, incoming.counted_at)
update toolbox_tool_click_events set counted = true where event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.select: select tool_id, click_count, last_counted_at, updated_at from toolbox_tool_click_totals where tool_id = #{toolId}
